description:
Shelvr is the save-for-later hub that organizes itself. Capture links, images, and quick notes — Shelvr reads each one, writes a clear title and summary, tags it, and files it into the right space automatically.

Bookmarks rot. Screenshots vanish. Tabs multiply. Shelvr turns the clutter into a quiet, searchable library you'll actually revisit — with AI doing the filing for you.

SAVE ANYTHING
• Paste a link, jot a note, or stash an image
• Save from any app with the iOS share sheet
• Photos, screenshots, articles, recipes — all in one place

AI DOES THE FILING
• Every save gets an automatic title, summary, and tags
• No folders to maintain, no tagging ritual
• Shelvr extracts the article text so you can read later without distractions

SPACES THAT FILL THEMSELVES
• Create a themed collection like “Design” or “Recipes”
• Shelvr reaches back through your existing saves and pulls in matching items
• New saves are auto-sorted into the right space going forward

FIND IT LATER
• Full-text search across titles, notes, tags, and extracted article text
• Browse your feed, open a space, or filter by tag
• Your saved places, plotted on a map

BONUS: TIDY YOUR CAMERA ROLL
• Swipe through your photos — keep, delete, or save into Shelvr
• Free up space without losing the shots that matter

Shelvr Pro is required to create new saves and use Pro features. The Monthly plan bills immediately. The Annual plan includes a 7-day free trial, then renews annually unless cancelled. Localized prices and terms appear before purchase. If Pro expires, existing saves remain available in read-only mode.

Subscriptions renew automatically. Restore, manage, or cancel from Profile or Apple ID settings.

Privacy: https://shelvr-web.vercel.app/privacy
Terms: https://shelvr-web.vercel.app/terms
promotionalText: Save links, notes and photos while AI organizes them. View Shelvr Pro plans; the Annual plan includes a 7-day free trial.
